title: Brett Veach: This draft has offensive line talent, but it dries up quickly after Round 1

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brett Veach: This draft has offensive line talent, but it dries up quickly after Round 1
sources.description: Chiefs General Manager Brett Veach has the No. 9, No. 29 and No. 40 overall picks in the 2026 NFL draft, and he's keeping a close eye on the offensive line prospects who might be available to him at those three picks.
